description: This source file provides AJAX utility functions for asynchronous HTTP requests, including a function to obtain XMLHttpRequest objects compatible across different browsers and a class 'VtigerAjax' to manage AJAX requests with customizable callbacks, specifically tailored for the Vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VtigerAjax
classes.description: A class encapsulating AJAX request functionality, allowing initialization with a callback and handling request states, process requests, and executing callback functions upon completion.

methods.name: getRequester()
methods.description: Creates and returns a cross-browser compatible XMLHttpRequest object.

methods.name: VtigerAjax
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes an AJAX request handler with an optional callback.

methods.name: requester.onreadystatechange
methods.description: Handles the state change of the XMLHttpRequest, executing the callback when the request is complete.

methods.name: state()
methods.description: Returns the current readyState of the XMLHttpRequest.

methods.name: process(url, parameters)
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous POST request to the specified URL with given parameters.
